text: Hey team, quick one—when we're on the forecast call, which dashboard are we supposed to use as the source of truth for pipeline coverage? I know there’s a few floating around.

Hey Jake, good question. For the forecast call specifically, we always use the 'RevOps Master Pipeline' dashboard in Tableau. I know it’s not in the handbook yet, but that’s the one leadership wants us referencing. The Salesforce view is just for day-to-day, but for the call, it’s always the Tableau one.
Ah, got it. Thanks Omar! I was looking at the Salesforce one last week, so that explains the numbers not matching up. Appreciate it.
No problem! Yeah, the Tableau dashboard pulls in the latest adjustments and manual overrides, so it’s the most up-to-date for those calls. If you need access or can’t find it, just ping me.
Thanks for clarifying, Omar. I think a few of us have been using the wrong one. Maybe we should add that to the onboarding doc?
